Search for an AI website builder with hosting included and you will find a lot of tools that technically qualify, right up until you try to publish. Then a banner appears asking for a credit card to remove a watermark, unlock a custom domain, or keep your site live past a trial window. Kodely works differently: describe a site in chat, get a real app, publish it, and the hosting part is just done. No upsell waiting in the fine print.

Why hosting included usually has an asterisk

Most free-tier site builders treat hosting as the upsell, not the feature. The pattern is familiar: you build for free, then discover that going live, keeping your site live, or getting real bandwidth requires a paid plan. Some throttle traffic on the free tier. Some strip HTTPS unless you pay. Some keep the word free on the homepage while quietly billing for the one thing that actually gets your site in front of visitors.

That is the gap Kodely is built to close. Hosting is not a plan tier or a trial. It is what happens automatically the moment you click Publish.

What is actually included with Kodely

When you publish from Kodely, you get a live site at your own name.kodely.site address, and that is the whole transaction. Specifically:

  • A public URL on the kodely.site domain, generated the moment you publish.
  • Automatic HTTPS on every published site, no configuration required.
  • No separate hosting invoice, ever. The credits you spend building the site are the only cost; staying online is not billed separately.
  • An automatic scan for accidentally leaked secrets or API keys before your site goes live, so a stray key in generated code cannot ship by accident.
  • Free rollbacks. Every successful generation creates a checkpoint, so if an edit breaks something you like, you can restore the previous version at no cost.

This is also a real application, not a static mockup. Kodely generates an actual Vite plus React 19 plus TypeScript plus Tailwind CSS v4 project, with real component files, and what you publish is that compiled app.

What is honestly not included yet

Being upfront about limits matters more than the marketing wins from hiding them. Today, Kodely does not support:

  • Custom domains. Your site lives at a kodely.site subdomain; connecting your own domain name is not available yet.
  • Backend, database, authentication, or payment generation. Kodely builds the frontend; it does not stand up servers or data layers.
  • Code export as a downloadable zip. You can view and copy the generated source files directly in the app, but there is no export button yet.
  • Click-to-edit visual editing. Changes happen by describing them in chat, and Kodely updates the real components accordingly.

If you need a custom domain or a backend today, Kodely is not the right fit yet. If you need a fast, real, live site for a project, a landing page, or a prototype, hosting included means exactly that.

How publishing actually works

There is no separate hosting step to configure. You describe the site, watch the live preview render the actual compiled app as it is built, and when it looks right, you click Publish once. Kodely assigns the kodely.site URL, applies HTTPS, runs the secret scan, and the site is live. Further changes go back through chat: describe what should change, and Kodely edits the real component files rather than regenerating from scratch.

Pricing in plain terms

Kodely uses one metered credit system for generation. There is no separate hosting fee layered on top, and a build that fails to compile is never charged.

PlanCreditsNotes
Free signup750 creditsNo credit card required
Top-up500 credits for $9Credits never expire
Top-up2,500 credits for $40Most popular
Top-up6,000 credits for $90Credits never expire

See the full breakdown on the pricing page.

FAQ

Is hosting really free forever, not just for a trial period?

Yes. Publishing to your kodely.site URL does not have a trial window and does not convert into a hosting bill later. The only thing you spend is credits, and those are spent on generation, not on staying online.

Can I connect my own domain name?

Not yet. Today every published site uses a kodely.site subdomain. A custom domain is not currently supported.

Do I own the code?

You can see and copy the generated source files inside the app. There is no zip export yet, so if you need to take the codebase to another host today, plan around that limitation.

What happens if a generation fails?

You are not charged for a build that fails to compile. Credits are only spent on successful generations.

Does Kodely build backends or logins?

No. Kodely currently generates the frontend only, using Vite, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4.

If a real, live site with no hosting bill sitting behind it is what you are after, start building free and publish your first version today.
